name: SIGMA - PowerShell Download and Execute via Invoke-Expression
author: Rocco <sheliak> Sicilia
description: Detects PowerShell executing commands downloaded from a remote HTTP/HTTPS source using Invoke-Expression or encoded commands. Covers common patterns including IEX, Net.WebClient, and Base64 encoded payloads.
false_positives: Administrative scripts that intentionally download and execute code
query: (process.executable:(*\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe)) AND (((process.command_line:(*Invoke\-Expression* OR *IEX*)) AND (process.command_line:(*Invoke\-WebRequest* OR *iwr* OR *wget* OR *curl* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *WebClient*)) AND (process.command_line:(*http* OR *https*))) OR ((process.command_line:(*\-enc\ * OR */enc\ *) OR process.command_line:(*\-encodedcommand\ * OR */encodedcommand\ *) OR process.command_line:(*\-ec\ * OR */ec\ *)) AND (process.command_line:(*http* OR *https*))))
